items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So then I went back to Kansas City and Basie asked me would I got to New York with him since he was leaving for New York shortly.

ctx.x: I hardly remember myself. So then I went back to Kansas City and Basie asked me would I got to New York with him since he was leaving for New York shortly. In about five weeks Basie was supposed to leave for New York.
Now, one reason he's asking you is, wasn't Lips Page supposed to go along?
